# Summary

In this markdown we will perform the following processing steps:

1. Load data, initialize objects, wrangle assays (including assigning HTODemux ids)
1. Visualize various QC metrics
1. Filter out low-quality cells
1. Filter out doublets 
1. Visualize data to check results of filters
1. Save finalized seurat object for later use

# Load, initialize, wrangle

Load the metadata, remove problem samples, load 10x files and convert to seurat objects

```{r meta, echo = T, results='hide'}
### Load metadata
meta_dt <- readAllExcel(file.path(baseDir_v, "novoMeta.xlsx"))$sheet1
colnames(meta_dt) <- c("MouseID", "Tissue", "Treatment", "Library Type", "Sample", "Sub Library Name", "Delivery Method",
                       "I7-index", "I5-index", "Insert Size", "Library Status", "Total Data Amt", "Data Unit", 
                       "Concentration", "Volume", "Species Type", "Notes")

meta_dt <- meta_dt[,mget(c("MouseID", "Tissue", "Treatment", "Sample", "Concentration", "Volume"))]
```

```{r subset meta}
badSamples_v <- c("B47", "B48")
meta_dt <- meta_dt[!(`Sample` %in% badSamples_v),]
```

```{r load data}
if (!file.exists(seuratFile_v)) {

  novo_lsobj <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(meta_dt)) {
    
    ### Get a sample and its path
    currSample_v <- meta_dt$Sample[i]
    currPath_v <- file.path(dataDir_v, currSample_v, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
    
    ### Read it in and convert to Seurat
    curr10x <- Read10X_h5(filename = currPath_v)
    currObj <- CreateSeuratObject(curr10x, project = currSample_v, min.cells = 3, min.features = 100)
    
    ### Add meta info
    currObj$mouseID <- meta_dt[Sample == currSample_v, MouseID]
    currObj$Tissue <- meta_dt[Sample == currSample_v, Tissue]
    currObj$Treatment <- meta_dt[Sample == currSample_v, Treatment]
    currObj$Sample <- currObj$orig.ident
    
    ### Add mito pct
    currObj$percent.mt <- PercentageFeatureSet(currObj, pattern = "^mt-")
    
    ### Add to list
    novo_lsobj[[currSample_v]] <- currObj
    
  } # for i
  
  saveRDS(novo_lsobj, file = seuratFile_v)
  
} else {
  
  novo_lsobj <- readRDS(seuratFile_v)
  
}
```

# Basic QC

```{r}
### Add complexity calculation
novo_lsobj <- lapply(novo_lsobj, function(x) {
  x$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(x$nFeature_RNA) / log10(x$nCount_RNA)
  return(x)})
```

```{r}
### Get Basic summary statistics
qcSummary_df <- rbindlist(lapply(names(novo_lsobj), function(x) {
  obj <- novo_lsobj[[x]]
  data.table(Sample = x,
             cellsBefore = ncol(obj),
             medGenes = median(obj$nFeature_RNA),
             medMito = median(obj$percent.mt))
}))
```

```{r QC plots}
### Combine all the metadata for plotting
cellMeta_df <- rbindlist(lapply(novo_lsobj, function(x) x@meta.data))
cellMeta_df$Treatment <- factor(cellMeta_df$Treatment, levels = intersect(names(treatColors_v), unique(cellMeta_df$Treatment)))
setorder(cellMeta_df, Treatment)
cellMeta_df$Sample <- factor(cellMeta_df$Sample, levels = unique(cellMeta_df$Sample))

preFilterQCDir_v <- mkdir(qcDir_v, "preFilter")
```

```{r umi}
### Plot UMI (nCount RNA)
nCountRNA_vln_gg <- ggplot(cellMeta_df, aes(x = Sample, y = nCount_RNA, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_violin() + 
  facet_wrap(~Tissue, scales = "free_x") + 
  ggtitle("UMI (nCount RNA)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treatColors_v, breaks = names(treatColors_v))

nCountRNA_vln_log10_gg <- nCountRNA_vln_gg + scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::label_comma())

### Plot as density
nCountRNA_density_gg <- ggplot(data = cellMeta_df, aes(color = Treatment, x = nCount_RNA, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) + my_theme() +
  facet_wrap(~Tissue) +
  ylab("Cell density") + geom_vline(xintercept = c(500, 1000, 1500)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = treatColors_v, breaks = names(treatColors_v)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treatColors_v, breaks = names(treatColors_v)) +
  ggtitle("Number of UMIs per cell\n(x-int = 500, 1000, 1500)")
```

# Subset

```{r}
invisible(gc())
### Filter objects based on standard thresholds
filter_lsobj <- lapply(novo_lsobj, function(x) {
  subset(x, subset = nFeature_RNA >= minGenesPerCell_v &
           #nFeature_RNA <= maxGenesPerCell_v &
           percent.mt <= maxPctMito_v)
})

### Evaluate number of cells removed
qcSummary_df[, cellsAfter := vapply(filter_lsobj, ncol, numeric(1))]
qcSummary_df[, pctRemoved := round(100 * (cellsBefore - cellsAfter) / cellsBefore, 1)]

### Check if we removed too many
filterWarning <- qcSummary_df[pctRemoved > 50]
if (nrow(filterWarning)) warning(sprintf("Some samples had >50%% cells removed: %s\n", paste(filterWarning$Sample, collapse = ", ")))

### Regardless of percentage, also need to make sure each sample still has minimum number of cells
filterKeeps <- vapply(filter_lsobj, ncol, numeric(1)) >= 500 # returns false if less than 500 cells
if (any(!filterKeeps)) message(sprintf("Dropping samples with <500 cells post-QC filter: %s\n", paste(names(filter_lsobj)[!filterKeeps], collapse = ", ")))
filter_lsobj <- filter_lsobj[filterKeeps]
```

```{r}
### Clean memory
rm(novo_lsobj)
invisible(gc())
```

```{r subset}
### Apply complexity filter
subset_lsobj <- lapply(filter_lsobj, function(x) subset(x, subset = log10GenesPerUMI >= 0.8))

### Combine all the metadata for plotting
subCellMeta_df <- rbindlist(lapply(subset_lsobj, function(x) x@meta.data))
subCellMeta_df$Treatment <- factor(subCellMeta_df$Treatment, levels = intersect(names(treatColors_v), unique(subCellMeta_df$Treatment)))
setorder(subCellMeta_df, Treatment)
subCellMeta_df$Sample <- factor(subCellMeta_df$Sample, levels = unique(subCellMeta_df$Sample))

postFilterQCDir_v <- mkdir(qcDir_v, "postFilter")
```

```{r}
### Clean memory
rm(filter_lsobj)
invisible(gc())
```

# How many cells are lost if we restrict to 500 genes?

```{r test subset, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, eval = F}
### Apply 500 gene minimum
testSub_ls <- lapply(subset_lsobj, function(x) subset(x, nFeature_RNA >= 500))

### Get number of cells from 200 and 500 gene minimums
filterStandard_v <- sapply(subset_lsobj, ncol)
filter500_v <- sapply(testSub_ls, ncol)

### Build a table of those and find their differences
filterCheck_dt <- data.table("Sample" = names(filterStandard_v), "pre" = filterStandard_v, "post" = filter500_v)
filterCheck_dt[, diff := pre - post]
filterCheck_dt[, pctDiff := round(diff/pre*100, 2)]

### Don't forget the treatments
filterCheck_dt <- merge(meta_dt[,mget(c("Treatment", "Sample"))], filterCheck_dt, by = "Sample", sort = F)

### Add a label for the high values
filterCheck_dt[pctDiff > 3, label := Sample]

colnames(filterCheck_dt) <- c("Sample", "Treatment", "Pre-Filter nCells", "Post-Filter nCells", "diff nCells", "pctDiff nCells", "label")

plotMelt_dt <- melt(filterCheck_dt, id.vars = c("Sample", "Treatment", "label"))

min500_gg <- ggplot(plotMelt_dt, aes(x = Treatment, y = value)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treatColors_v, breaks = names(treatColors_v)) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") +
  my_theme() +
  ggtitle("Difference b/w 200 and 500 nFeature")

min500_gg

ggplot(filterCheck_dt, aes(x = `Pre-Filter nReads`, y = `pctDiff nReads`, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = treatColors_v, breaks = names(treatColors_v)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label))

rm(testSub_lsobj)
invisible(gc())
```
